reviews.title: Easy for those techie gals and guys! Love the efficiency!
reviews.comment: As a busy mom, I often rely on my tech to keep everything running smoothly, and the MSI PRO H610M-G WiFi DDR4 ProSeries Motherboard has been a fantastic addition to my setup. It’s reliable, easy to install, and has all the features I need, including WiFi capabilities, which has been a huge plus. I’ve noticed my computer runs much faster and more efficiently with this motherboard. It’s perfect for everything from work tasks to family movie nights. For anyone looking for an upgrade, this motherboard offers great performance and value, and it’s definitely worth the investment.
reviews.author: Samantha

reviews.title: Everything works
reviews.comment: I used this in a recent build. Assembly requires inserting the included wifi card and connecting the antennae. Upon building the system I flashed the bios to the most recent version, installed Windows 11, then the Intel chipset drivers, as well as the Realtek audio, bt, and wifi drivers. The system runs well and stable. Everything works as it should. The audio sounds excellent, I have strong wifi connection, and I can carry my bt speaker throughout both floors of my house without losing signal. The matx format allowed for a compact build, which I like. One point to note is that there is only one case fan header, which I was not aware of. I ended up buying a splitter in order to run two fans. The header supplies 2A current, way more than my two fans consume, 2 x 0.16A = 0.32A, which puts the issue to rest.
reviews.author: Sepp Seitz

reviews.title: Headache with Windows 10, but all good now.
reviews.comment: I installed a I7 12700kf, 32gb Corsair 3200, WD sn770 1tb M2, and MSI RTX 2060 12GB. I had to disable the Lan, to stop getting lockups during the Windows 10 install ( it took alot of trial an error to figure that out). Then I would get random freezes after 5 minutes of idling. I had to manually set the E cores to 2.7 in the Bios, with the latest Bios flashed (1/2024). I had to download the wifi and bluetooth AC9260 drivers from Intel, because they are not available on the support site. Everything is running great now.
